I’m not able to pull up live enrollment schedules from universities directly.  
If you’re looking for whether there’s space left in particular classes (e.g., introductory physics, business analytics, creative writing) during May 2025 at the University of Sydney, here are some steps you could take:

| Step | What to do |
|------|------------|
| **1️⃣ Identify the Course** | Write down the exact course code or title (e.g., *ENGG1010 – Engineering Fundamentals*). If it’s part of a degree program, note the major or faculty. |
| **2️⃣ Use the Student Portal** | Log into the Uni‑Sydney student portal (myUniSyd) and navigate to “Course Registration” → “Search Courses.” You’ll see current enrolment numbers vs capacity. |
| **3️⃣ Contact Academic Advisers** | Each faculty has advisers who know seat limits and waitlist status. Email or call them—most departments list contact details on their webpages. |
| **4️⃣ Look at Waitlists** | Some courses allow a waitlist even when full. Ask if you’d like your name added. |
| **5️⃣ Explore Alternative Sections** | Often the same subject runs multiple times per semester. Switching sections might free up a spot. |

### Quick Tips:
- **Deadlines:** For most undergraduate programs, registration opens around late March–early April for Semester 2 (which starts mid‑April), so act fast once seats open.
- **Prerequisites:** Make sure all required prerequisites are satisfied before attempting to register.
- **Online Resources:** Many faculties publish a PDF timetable each year showing class timings, room capacities, and instructor names.

---

#### Need More Specific Help?

If you let me know:
- The exact course code/title,
- Your study level (undergraduate/postgraduate),
- Whether you’re already enrolled as a student,

I can give more tailored advice on how to proceed—or point you toward official resources where you can confirm availability yourself.
